LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.Smartstore.Split3D
LocaleResource.Value: Issues signed Split3D activation keys, automatically for paid orders or manually in the admin area.

LocaleResource.Name: Addons.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Each addon is one Blender module sold as its own ZIP. The product code must equal the PRODUCT constant in the addon's license_core.py; all addons share the signing key configured in Settings.

LocaleResource.Name: Addon.ProductCodeInvalid
LocaleResource.Value: Product code: 2–100 characters, lowercase letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_'.

LocaleResource.Name: Addon.ProductCodeExists
LocaleResource.Value: Another addon already uses this product code.

LocaleResource.Name: Addon.ProductCodeLocked
LocaleResource.Value: The product code cannot be changed because keys were already issued for this addon.

LocaleResource.Name: Addon.ProductCodeNote
LocaleResource.Value: Must equal PRODUCT = '...' in the addon's license_core.py. Keys for one addon do not unlock another.

LocaleResource.Name: Addon.NoProducts
LocaleResource.Value: No products are mapped to this addon yet.

LocaleResource.Name: Addon.UnmapConfirm
LocaleResource.Value: Remove this product from the addon? The product itself is kept, but buyers will no longer receive keys for it.

LocaleResource.Name: Addon.CreateProductsHint

LocaleResource.Name: Addon.UploadVersionHint
LocaleResource.Value: Attaches the ZIP to all products of this addon. Customers who bought it can download the newest version.

LocaleResource.Name: Import.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Upload a CSV or XLSX file with a "Key" column (e.g. the export of the old License Studio). Email, name and dates are read from the signed key; Price, PurchaseDate, KeyType, Phone and Notes columns are optional. Keys that already exist are skipped.

LocaleResource.Name: KeyStatus.Valid

LocaleResource.Name: KeyStatus.NoPrivateKey
LocaleResource.Value: The private signing key is not configured. Keys can be imported but not issued.

LocaleResource.Name: Setup.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Creates the Split3D products (3 months, 6 months, 1 year, lifetime) with pictures and the addon file as download, sets Vietnamese and VND as defaults, enables bank transfer as the only payment method, simplifies checkout for digital goods and replaces the home page. Save the bank details above first. Safe to run again: existing products keep their prices.
